All 2,652 resolved identities checked and all 1,564 non-source bindings rehashed.

Entire original/successor ASTs agree after exactly nine O-to-ORIGINAL_AUTHOR occurrences and one write-only CIF-loop binding rename. Exact original bytes and archive plus root successor receipt are bound. Independent normalization reproduces the declared hash; source-literal change, extra assertion and newly read unused binding are rejected.

Each actual subprocess exit is recorded and nonzero exits raise before success. Child target/scope/native-member/predecessor/evidence counts and every reported child input are checked. Fresh external output, exclusive files and failure receipts prevent treating a failed or prior attempt as a new pass. Root must still observe the actual tool terminal.

All source/prior-proof inputs are rehashed first, followed by current formal inputs, inventories and manifest. Child receipt and all child logs are checked after slow source reads; output path, resolved destination and inode identity are rechecked before exclusive success emission.

Optimization is rejected at wrapper startup and removed from child environment. Declared venv path/prefix/version and interpreter bytes are bound; children use safe path, no user site, disabled writes and a fresh cache prefix. Distribution metadata is accurately scoped as provenance, not all dependency implementation attestation. Source replay is explicitly not scientific approval, and history/pages/full gates/canonical review remain separate.
